summary: Customer inquired about setting up NEFT transfer and was assisted.

intents.keywords: How do I set up NEFT ... takes 24 hours to activate

issues.issue: Customer needs guidance on setting up NEFT transfer.
issues.reason(s): New savings account holder unfamiliar with the NEFT transfer process.

intents.actions of agent: The agent explained the process of setting up NEFT transfer using the mobile app.
intents.resolution: The agent informed the customer to go to the apps transfer section and add a beneficiary with account number and IFSC code. It takes 24 hours to activate.
